title: DIY Outdoor Table for Summer Family Gatherings
excerpt: A sturdy 6‑seater outdoor table built with pressure‑treated solid wood, designed for family gatherings and long summer days outdoors.
body: ## Overview Outdoor tables play a central role during the summer months, creating a welcoming space where family and friends can gather to share meals, talk and enjoy time together. In this project, I built a solid 6‑seater outdoor table with a rounded design, ideal for outdoor lunches, dinners and relaxed evenings on the porch or in the garden. ## Design & Purpose A well‑designed outdoor table encourages conversation and makes shared moments more comfortable. The rounded shape allows everyone to interact easily, making it perfect for family gatherings, barbecues and casual summer meals. ## Materials Used For this build I used **pressure‑treated solid wood boards** supplied by **Carmo Wood**. Pressure‑treated wood is an excellent choice for outdoor furniture because it offers: - High resistance to moisture and insects - Long‑term durability in exterior conditions - Reduced maintenance over time ## About Carmo Wood Carmo Wood is a Portuguese group composed of 10 companies, with the entire transformation, product creation and technical development process based in Portugal. The company operates in sectors such as agriculture, construction, tourism, leisure, security and telecommunications. Based in Portugal, Carmo Wood has four manufacturing units located in Pegões, Almeirim and Oliveira de Frades, and international presence in Spain and France, with offices in Madrid, Algeciras and Bordeaux. ## Build Process The table was built with a focus on strength and stability to support everyday outdoor use. Careful attention was given to joint construction, alignment and overall rigidity to ensure a long‑lasting structure suitable for frequent family use. ## Finishing Proper finishing is essential for outdoor furniture. The table was treated to protect the wood from sun exposure, moisture and temperature changes, helping preserve its appearance and durability throughout the seasons. ## Final Result The final result is a strong, functional and inviting outdoor table that becomes the centerpiece of summer gatherings. It is a practical project that combines durability, comfort and aesthetics — perfect for enjoying outdoor living with family and friends. ## Image Gallery ![OT](/images/posts/OT1.jpg) ![OT](/images/posts/OT2.png) ![OT](/images/posts/OT3.png) ![OT](/images/posts/OT4.png) ![OT](/images/posts/OT5.png) ## Contact If you build a similar outdoor table, feel free to share your results or ideas. 👉 Contact me via the contact page
